name: Smart Diff 'View finding' routes to that finding's card
description: From PR #482's Files changed tab (Smart order), click the per-line 'View finding' button on a flagged line and confirm it navigates IN-APP to the Agent-runs tab with ?finding=<id> and reveals that finding's card — not GitHub, not a popup. (The file header's 'N finding' badge is deliberately NOT a route: it only expands that file card and scrolls to its flagged line.) The first Core-logic file is src/api/users.ts, whose seeded finding is 'N+1 query in user list endpoint'; its card sorts second (below the CRITICAL one) so it is NOT expanded by default — seeing its rationale proves the deep link targeted THAT card. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
